module: Rally editor helper to "snap" a point's height (z) to the terrain. Three methods: none, terrain height (core_terrain.getTerrainHeight) or vertical raycast (editorUtil.vertRaycast). The current method comes from the rally editor preference (editor_rallyEditor.getPrefWaypointSnapMethod). Also used to fit a spline's geometry to the terrain.
usage:
local zSnap = extensions.editor_rallyEditor_zSnap
local p = zSnap.zSnap(vec3(100, 200, 0), zSnap.methods.vertRaycast, 10)
notes: The "InPlace" functions modify the vec3 passed as argument (pos.z) and return it; zSnap() works on a copy.
An unknown method in snapInPlace falls back to defaultMethod (getTerrainHeight).
snapTerrainHeightInPlace changes nothing if core_terrain.getTerrainHeight is absent or returns nil.

methods.desc: Method names: noSnapping, getTerrainHeight, vertRaycast (values = displayable labels).

methodValues.desc: Ordered list of method labels (for a dropdown).

noSnappingInPlace.desc: Does nothing, returns pos as is.

snapTerrainHeightInPlace.desc: Sets pos.z to the terrain height at (x, y) if available.

snapRaycastInPlace.desc: Adjusts pos.z by a vertical raycast (editorUtil.vertRaycast).

rayRaise.desc: Height the ray is raised by before firing (passed to vertRaycast).

isValidMethod.desc: Returns whether the label is a known method.

snapInPlace.desc: Applies the chosen method (or the default method if unknown) to pos, in place.

zSnap.desc: Like snapInPlace but on a copy of pos.

getCurrentMethod.desc: Returns the method chosen in the rally editor preferences, or defaultMethod if absent/invalid.

zSnapWithCurrentMethod.desc: zSnap with the current method, on a copy.

methodForUseRaycast.desc: Converts a boolean to a method: vertRaycast if true, otherwise getTerrainHeight.

snapDrivelineInPlace.desc: Snaps a driveline point to the terrain with the method inferred from useRaycast.

conformSplineGeometry.desc: Generates the geometry of a Catmull-Rom spline snapped to the terrain, by raycast (geom.catmullRomRaycast) or by terrain height (geom.catmullRomConformToTerrain).

minNumDivisions.desc: Minimum number of subdivisions (passed to geom).

returns.desc: Result of the geom function called.
